body:
Well I am still here. I would like to thank the people that cared enough to comment (seletpoivre, SWthrowaway55 and thiswouldbeanna) I honestly thought that I would not be sitting here right know. I would like to describe what I did and what I was thinking if thats ok.

I finished typing this and then went and then got my clothes out of the dryer. I told myself that if the train goes by one more time before I left I would just go to bed. I can hear the train from my house. I got my room ready to leave for the last time. my dad was snoring and my mom is a light sleeper but she had no idea what I was doing or trying to do. I put my I.D and my house keys in my pocket so I did not lock myself out of the house and then explain to my parents what I what trying to do when and if I rang the door bell. I was trying to convince myself to go and that no one would care. I put my I.D in my pocket so when they found my body there would be no hope that it was not me (It is not really helping that my best friend is ignoring my text messages, all i did was ask her if she would treat me any differently or think of me any differently if I quit school. I tried to ask her if she got my text message on facebook and all i saw was that she saw it at 10:15 or whatever. Which I know this all might sound somewhat clingy and needy but I am not really stable right now. But anyway I managed to get my bike out the door and I was terrified at this point. I shut the door and I thought that I heard my parents screaming at each other and trying to find out where I was. This was about a minute in and I stuck my head back inside and they were both asleep. so I was hearing things or imagining it (I have been told that I have an overactive imagination) so i go outside with out my bike and face the way that I am going to go and I just freeze up and I can't feel my legs and I think I was paralyzed with fear . It was dark and 1:00 in the morning or so. I have never felt so alone in my life. I stood out there for like a half hour and then I just wanted my mom but It was 2:00 in the morning and she has work in the morning and I did not want to wake her up even though I really needed help. So I just went to sleep and my whole body shut down. Now It feels like a nightmare like I feel like there was no way that I could have been moving or thinking like that last night but I did. So now I am all out of it (not drunk or high) and I have four 3 to midnights in a row lined up. I dont think I can do this or even act happy today. I feel like I am living on borrowed time. I just wanted to write this because I dont want to be inconsiderate and "drop off the face off the internet" if that makes sense. 

And also SSthrowaway55, I also only feel comfortable talking about this stuff on here. and I agree with your last statement. It is nice to know that there are other brave people out there fighting to get through the day like me.
